name: Joseph Minish
summary: Joseph George Minish (September 1, 1916 – November 24, 2007) was an American labor organizer and Democratic Party politician who represented New Jersey in the United States House of Representatives from 1963 to 1985. He represented New Jersey's 11th congressional district, which centered on Newark and suburban Essex County, until redistricting resulted in his defeat by Republican Dean Gallo in the 1984 elections.
